question:
Choose the one word substitute for the below sentence.

John asked his neighbor, a person who repairs and maintains machines called?
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Mechanic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

 
• **Mechanic** refers to a person who repairs and maintains machinery, especially motor vehicles. (मकैनिक: मशीनों की मरम्मत और रखरखाव करने वाला व्यक्ति)

 

 
• **Example:** The mechanic quickly identified the issue with my car and fixed it within an hour.

 

 
• The role of a mechanic is highly specialized and involves a deep understanding of mechanical systems.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1 i.e. Mechanic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Technician** (तकनीशियन): A person skilled in the technical aspects of a particular field. 

 

 
• **Example:** The technician installed the software on my computer efficiently.

 

 

 
• **Engineer** (अभियंता): A professional trained in designing, building, and maintaining structures, machines, or systems.

 

 
• **Example:** The engineer designed a new bridge to replace the old one.

 

 

 
• **Operator** (ऑपरेटर): A person who operates machinery or equipment.

 

 
• **Example:** The crane operator carefully lifted the heavy steel beams into position.
